text:
Life insurance provides financial protection for beneficiaries
in the event of the insured person's death.

Customers must be between 18 and 65 years old to purchase
the standard life insurance product.
Premiums depend on age, coverage amount, and policy duration.

Customers can purchase the policy online if they meet the
eligibility requirements.
Employees are entitled to 12 days of annual leave per year.

Employees must complete at least 3 months of employment before
they can request annual leave.
Leave requests must be submitted through the HR system.

Employees should submit leave requests at least 3 working days
before the requested leave date.
Managers are responsible for approving or rejecting leave requests.
